view.label: Familias Periodo
view.sqlSentence: SELECT pcategory.id, pcategory.name, SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3), 0)), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2), 0)), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, 0, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3))), SUM(IF(invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ?, 0, TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2))) FROM pcategory, invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE invoice_detail.item = item.id AND item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND ( invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? OR invoice.issue_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(?, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND DATE_SUB(?, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ) AND invoice.type = ? GROUP BY 1,2
